title: Spinner without progress context
summary: An indefinite spinner by itself does not explain what is loading, whether existing content remains usable, or what the user can do if the wait fails.
problem: Users cannot distinguish normal work from a stalled request and may lose context while the interface blanks.
use_when: Auditing loading states that replace substantial content with a generic centered spinner
avoid_when: A very short local operation has obvious scope and completes before richer feedback would help
rationale: Loading feedback should match wait length and task scope.
Existing content can often remain visible while refresh occurs.

signals: whole page replaced with indefinite spinner for partial refresh
no error or retry state follows failed loading
